description: Create managed version history for an unbound project. Normal blank chat uses vite-react; existing local files use source_publish instead. Returns an asynchronous operation; poll operation_get and source_get with include_binding true before planning the resulting commit. Does not publish an application.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: source_initialize
